messages:
Nia (CS): Alert — some APAC trial tenants saw delayed onboarding webhooks starting ~01:05 UTC. Drafting brief to impacted customers.
Omar (Eng): Deploy change increased debounce window; reverted and restarted workers. Monitoring.
StatusBot: Restart job/webhook-ingester complete. Health: nominal.
Rina (Support): Can we add a short workaround for customers who need immediate event visibility?
Omar (Eng): Temporary workaround: enable event-log export in tenant settings to pull missed payloads (support can trigger manual export).
Tomas (Billing): Offering a one-time credit for affected accounts by request; will prepare PR.
Nia (CS): Short customer note ready: "We experienced delayed delivery of onboarding webhooks for some APAC tenants. The issue is fixed and deliveries are resuming. If you need help recovering missed events, book an office-hours slot or request a manual export. We'll follow up with an RCA."
Rina (Support): I'll send the Intercom to impacted tiers once Nia approves. Please upload affected tenant list.
Omar (Eng): Backfill started; most tenants will be current within 12 hours; a few large accounts may take longer. Postmortem items: tighten retry tests and add an alert for suppressed queues.
Nia (CS): Uploaded CSV and approved send. Will include office-hours link and credit wording. Closing for now; will paste RCA when ready.
